rationale: The agent verified the user via email using the tool, then fetched the user’s orders and addresses with read-only tools. It identified the Washington, DC address from a prior order as requested and listed possible addresses for the user to choose without revealing new details. Before making any changes, the agent clearly stated the exact update (apply the DC address to all pending orders) and listed the pending orders (#W2166301, #W2466703, #W6832752), then obtained explicit confirmation. It performed the updates using the appropriate modify tool for each pending order and reported the final updated address. No unsupported claims were made, no changes were performed without confirmation, and actions were confined to the authenticated user’s account. Although the scenario preface mentions updating the default address, the user never requested that in the conversation; the agent correctly limited actions to the user’s explicit request.
